notes: Tempo test: multi-band (5-band log spectral flux) onset envelope; tatum grid fit gives 137.9 ms everywhere (intro, post-drop, whole). That tatum = a 16th at 108.8 BPM or a triplet-8th at 145.1 BPM. Meter test: onset autocorrelation at 16 tatums (2.206 s) = 0.49 intro / 0.24 post-drop vs 12 tatums (a 145-BPM bar) = 0.13 / 0.06, the intro sub hits repeat every 2.205 s, and post-drop claps repeat every 2.2057 s for 7 bars (+-1 ms). So the music is 108.8 BPM 4/4; '145 BPM' is the dotted-8th pulse (3 x 16th = 0.414 s) of the 3-3-2 syncopation. Straight 16ths at 145 BPM fit worse (score 1.04 vs 1.17).

Grid: intro and post-drop grids agree on tempo (108.85 vs 108.82 BPM) with a 12 ms phase offset; the drop 808 starts 19 ms before the post-drop grid line (12.600 vs 12.619). Treat 12.60 as THE cut frame.
The drop lands exactly 2 bars after the last intro downbeat (8.20) and 1 bar after the scream bar starts (10.41); the track then runs 8 bars to the end (bar 8 would be 30.27, music stops 30.165).

Scream measured on the 1-6 kHz band at 5-10 ms resolution: first rise 10.48, attack 10.49-10.51; main body ends when 3-6 kHz falls 6 dB at 12.03-12.06; low-level tail continues under the riser to the 808 pickup at 12.33.

Final edit timings (same as SCRIPT.md sections 4 and 5.3; earlier suggestions are superseded): T1 'why use SoundCloud' 0.00-3.79 (f0-113), T2 'or Spotify' 3.79-5.99 (f114-179), T3 'why!?!?' 5.99-9.50 with the fade-out from 9.30 (f180-284), breath 9.03-10.49 = freeze frame with a slow zoom, T4 'WHYYYYYYY' 10.49-12.60 (f315-377, hidden f322-327), white frames on the 12.60 drop (f378-380), transformation 12.70-13.72, first product beat (icon slam + 'just use Tikify') on the 13.72 clap (f412), captions c2-c11 on the post-drop beats 14.83-28.05, end card 28.05-30.17 (f842-904).

Strongest visual moments to save for the product: 12.60 drop, 14.83 / 17.03 / 19.24 downbeats, 21.43 808-hold (second impact - good for a hero/logo hold), 25.17 808 accent, 28.05 last bar into the end card.
MP3 metadata durations (ffprobe) include LAME padding (+0.03-0.05 s), so cut files were made 14.96 s / 29.96 s decoded so every reader reports <= 15.0 s / <= 30.0 s.

Two-clip plan: part1 + part2 butt together sample-exactly at 14.8333 s (frame 445 @30 fps, frame 356 @24 fps; 7 ms after the bar-1 downbeat attack). Null test of part1+part2 vs source: residual -45 dBFS (codec noise only). For the final edit, lay the 30 s file under the whole stitched timeline so any per-clip MP3 padding cannot drift.
